test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: R, S, T, U, V and W are six cousins sitting around a circular dinner table facing the centre of the table. U is seated second to the right of S. T is seated to the immediate right of U. R is an immediate neighbour of both W and T. Who is seated to the immediate right of S?
solution:
**Given: **R, S, T, U, V and W are six cousins sitting around a circular dinner table facing the centre of the table. 

1) T is seated to the immediate right of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffdbcf6eb705a58f77c11f781d97b85a1ca8e8dbdf975c9a9e66812ff3ca92b6.png] 

2) R is an immediate neighbour of both W and T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a6027355642d6a99d0c58afbf528fc92eab2f61880bd2d124cffe1a4e085822.png] 

3) U is seated second to the right of S. 

After positioning S only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e86ec392b2a6590b2a37e4e40eea823a302c7343ff73ba83c3fe94d89a78678.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, V is seated to the immediate right of S.

Hence,** "Option 4"** is the correct answer.
